items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I'm looking here, The Red Callender Six. That was with Herbie Haymer, Arnold Ross, Les Paul, Shadow Wilson.

ctx.x: That was somewhere in the Porties, during this same period, as a matter of fact. Because this was way before Jazz at the Philharmonic. I remember that, because I was one of the first... Well, we did the first one ever. Nat Cole and Les Paul (he called himself "Paul Leslie" to get away with it), Shorty Sherrock, Jack McVea, Illinois Jacquet, Lee Young. Nat played piano; he called himself "Shorty Nadine" on the records that were released from that. And this was done down on 5th Street, huh, at the Philharmonic. I…
